headline: On October 10, 2007: Sheikh Muszaphar Shukor launches to ISS
captionCards: First Malaysian in space aboard Soyuz TMA-11
instagramCaption:
Malaysian doctor Sheikh Muszaphar Shukor became the first Malaysian in space. He launched aboard Soyuz TMA-11 with Expedition 16 on October 10, 2007. His mission was part of the Angkasawan program agreement with Russia. He returned to Earth on October 21, 2007, alongside Fyodor Yurchikhin and Oleg Kotov. This historic flight marked a significant milestone for Malaysia's participation in international space exploration. Would you want to experience zero gravity?
